# ffxf_database_queries (Data Source)

Reads FFXF Cloud database API data. Database features are in beta; accounts without access receive HTTP 403.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_database_queries" "current" {
  database_id = 42
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (Number) ID of the database to query.

### Read-Only

- `queries_json` (String) Recent database query statistics as JSON.
